_comment: The starred default values a K2's PROMOTION_TERMS_V1 may take, copied verbatim from the frozen plan texts, one source reference each (document, section, quoted words, the number as written, its unit). Nothing here is invented: a value with no source in those texts is absent (see not_set), and a layer whose metric is not yet defined is not usable. Supplied to the K2 freeze program as ctx.promotionTermsStar; an AI-authored draft must equal it, a human-authored one states its own values. To be frozen by plan-coord from the PR that adds it.

V1_1.doc: 三市场量化研究与交易计划系统_完整优化方案_V1.1

RISK.reason: V1.1 5.2 B prescribes the fallback itself until CVaR5 is defined in METRIC_DEFINITIONS V1.1: risk questions keep the existing gates (non-inferiority to the control D8, or the touch-probability difference X06). A RISK draft therefore uses DT-NON-INFERIORITY-V1 with margin_sd from the registered risk rule it cites; the metric is named for what is measured, NON_INFERIORITY_D8 (the D8 gate, d38f87a9) or TOUCH_PROBABILITY_DIFF_X06 (the X06 touch-probability difference), and min 0 means not worse than the control; CVAR5_IMPROVEMENT stays reserved. The CVaR5 path stays star_missing until CVaR5 is defined.
RISK.fallback_quote: 在此之前，风险题沿用现行的门：不劣于对照（D8，d38f87a9）或触线概率差（X06）

EXECUTION.reason: V1.1 5.2 C gives no economic-value number for execution and plan improvements (only the cost x2 check)
